content: If you are in Canada and have concerns about side effects, contact your doctor for medical advice. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. If the situation is less urgent, contact a poison control center without delay. For residents of the United States, the poison control center can be reached at 1-800-222-1222. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Medications should be discarded properly when they are expired or no longer needed. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024.
